text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
Intensive training to improve skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can hear the sound of waves...
The sea must be nearby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Training oneself out in nature truly has the feel of ascetic discipline, doesn't it? Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's so much to do
in preparation for the Kikuka Sho
and its trial race, the Kobe Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, that's enough chatting.
Let's get right into training!
—The intense summer training camp with Mejiro McQueen has begun.
